question: Which stellar-temperature/spot, extinction/partial-covering and two-component occultation models can reproduce the existing optical-infrared change and predict new color changes?
known: All current g/W1/W2 amplitudes are already known; these are retrospective model checks, not blind discoveries. Full historical raw and GaiaXP availability known; additional recovered archive measurements not yet inspected by root.
primary_data: 2018→2022 March matched-season median ASASg change median(bi=.304,bm=.312,bq=.3405)=.312mag; correctedW1=.1175mag; fitg+W1 only. W2=.08875mag is excluded from optimization. October g=.3225,W1=.115,W2=.09 is sensitivity.
models: Uniform foreground DraineRv3.1/4/5.5attenuation screen, one amplitude.
CK04 stellar cooling at fixed area, one temperature change.
CK04 temperature change plus wavelength-independent geometric scale, two fitted quantities.
CK04 two-temperature surface: varying cool-spot covering fraction with fixed broad initialT/gravity/metallicity grids.
Partial covering by finite-optical-depth Draine screen, coveringfraction+opticaldepth.
Gray eclipse of one of two different-temperature stellar spectra with constant uneclipsed component: scale ratio+coveredfraction. This spectral geometry does not validate a companion/orbit.
Pure gray single-component dimming as a simple reference.
atmosphere_grid: Public STScI Castelli-Kurucz2004 spectra, Teff3500–6500K/250K, logg2.0,2.5,3.0 and[M/H]−1,−.5,0 sensitivities; no catalogue output assumed exact. Interpolate flux linearly inT inside grid only. Reject zero/nonpositive modelbands. Coldspots below3500K are outside this limited model family.
bandpasses: SVO published transmissions including SDSSg (proxyforASASg),WISEW1/W2,JohnsonBV,SDSSgriz,2MASSJHKs; inspectdetectorresponseandunitmetadata. Integrate spectra overpassbands withcorrect photon/energyweighting. ZTFg sensitivity iffilteravailable. g-cameraresponse/atmosphereuncertainty separate from samplingerror.
fitting: Use bounded grid/profile search or deterministic optimization. Fitonlyg/W1 for primaryflexiblemodels, recordingnumberoffreeparameters, boundarysolutions andnuisanceparameter dependence. Do notpickmodelusingW2thenclaimindependentprediction. ReportW2residuals anddistinctnewcolorpredictions. One-parameter models neednotexactlyfitbothtrainingbands.
forecast_colors: Savepredictedfaint-minus-bright B−V,g−r,V−I,J−H,H−Ks,g−Ks for matched∆g states, includingnuisance/modelranges. These colors are unmeasuredeventpredictions, not evidence of mechanism.
uncertainty: Broad systematic floors .02mag optical andW1,.03magW2 for descriptive residualscale sensitivities; notcalibratedlikelihood/modelprobability orcauseconfidence. Preserveactualsampling/controlrangesfrompreviousresults.
